overview: This Senate resolution expresses sorrow at the death of actor and martial artist Chuck Norris, who died on March 19, 2026, at age 86. It recounts his life, including his birth in Oklahoma, his service as an Air Force police officer in South Korea where he took up martial arts, his six straight professional middleweight karate championships, and his acting career in films and the TV series "Walker, Texas Ranger." It also notes his charity that teaches martial arts to middle-school students and his support for veterans and troops. The resolution asks the Secretary of the Senate to send it to the House. It does not change any law or spending. The Senate approved it, and as of April 22, 2026, it had been sent to the House.
for: Supporters say it honors an Air Force veteran and cultural figure who supported troops and young people through his charity work.
against: Critics say the resolution is ceremonial and doesn't change any law or spending.
